config.label: Optional Base mainnet RPC endpoint (Alchemy, Infura, etc) for higher rate limits
config.description: Optional Base mainnet RPC endpoint (Alchemy, Infura, etc) for higher rate limits. Must match the allowlist in src/rpc/allowlist.ts; non-allowlisted URLs fall back to public Base RPC with a stderr warning. Defaults to https://mainnet.base.org if unset.
